For nearly 20 years, Saint Paul, Minnesota-based AiR Healthcare Solutions has treated people with chronic behavioral health disorders, as well as developed and improved a new model for behavioral health.

To help manage these complex interactions and large volumes of data, AiRCare uses Health360 Care Coordination—based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 —developed by Tribridge, a DXC technology company and member of the Microsoft Partner Network.
